title: Papa' s got a brand new bag - JAMES BROWN

lines.l: Papa's got a brand new bag
It's a jack, he's doing the fly
Don't play him cheap, cause you know he's shy
He's doing the monkey, the mashed potato
Jump back, jack, say you later
But I can dig the new breathing
He's got a brand new bag
But Baba, you're doin' the drag
It's a thing, like a boomerang
Hey, hey, set you up tight
